title: Implement Guard-owned providers and explicit Stage dependencies
goal: Execute or validate exact readiness and analysis dependencies without changing direct Stage semantics or CI authority.
acceptanceCriteria: Guard-owned readiness and analysis providers are registered with no network and no TargetRoot write capability.
Semantic Module result kinds are accepted only in their matching Stage roles.
Direct semantic Pre and Post fail closed without fresh exact provider Evidence.
With-dependencies exposes ordered executed or reused provider steps and never promotes provider success into a gate result.
Legacy v1 direct and with-dependencies behavior remains byte-contract compatible.
risks: A stale or partial provider result could be mistaken for a gate dependency.
decisions: Bind local dependencies to exact content and producer identities and label their reuse advisory.
